artifacts.name: postgresql
artifacts.review: Source build without ICU/readline/compression/NLS, system timezone data. Generated configure is shipped by PostgreSQL; no Autoconf tool installed. Pre-existing platform compiler/make/Perl/Bison/Flex/shell are inherited infrastructure, not repository-installed dependencies. PostgreSQL 17 requires Bison/Flex even from release source. Generated configure uses FSFUL; The bundled X11 install-sh helper is not executed; platform mkdir/install are explicitly selected instead. It is not redistributed by Mayi. config.guess/config.sub and generated Bison parser headers grant additional permission to distribute under PostgreSQL terms; that branch is selected and full notice headers are retained. No additional generator is installed. Generated parser output uses the explicit permission for PostgreSQL distribution terms.

artifacts.name: openbao
artifacts.review: Unmodified exact source; build CGO_ENABLED=0 without ui tag. Dev in-memory server, no cloud seal/storage. All linked source modules and local upstream replacements reviewed, source links retained. No production/HSM certification.
